human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Implement the first deterministic projection builder over stored/imported evidence: run identity, source, start/end/duration, lifecycle, execution outcome, task/iteration counts when evidence supports them. Unknown evidence must remain unknown. Dependency: 8010.add-execution-projection-model.
human_pressure.why_now: Run Report needs a stable headline state before richer validation/runtime/change details.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No signal/risk inference in this pack.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Build lifecycle/outcome projection from generic evidence events and source metadata using explicit deterministic rules.
red_lines: No signal/risk inference in this pack.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8010.add-execution-projection-model. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Builder consumes stored normalized evidence only.
contracts: Lifecycle/outcome rules are explicit and tested.
failure_semantics: Insufficient evidence -> unknown with diagnostics/evidence state, not guessed.

steps.title: Build projection context
details: Projection accepts event types as strings and source payloads.

steps.title: Derive times/lifecycle
details: Do not infer completion from last timestamp alone.

steps.title: Derive execution outcome
details: Map source outcomes through explicit source-neutral categories while retaining native value in DecisionRecord.

steps.title: Derive work counts
details: Only when evidence provides task/iteration identifiers or counts.
Otherwise unknown/zero-with-evidence semantics must be unambiguous.

acceptance: Completed successful run projects success without losing native decision.
Partial run projects partial, not generic failed.
Missing terminal evidence projects unknown/incomplete rather than success.
Projection is deterministic for ordered identical evidence.

reject_if: Last event timestamp alone marks run completed.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
